screens_created.name: Chat Tab — Channel List
screens_created.description: The primary chat entry point showing all public channels, ordered by recent activity. Unread counts and last message preview help users prioritise.
screens_created.layout_notes: Uses existing BottomNavBar with Chat tab active. Channel list items use ListItem/Channel component (unread variant for unseen channels). Top search bar uses InputField/default. Pull-to-refresh gesture supported.

screens_created.name: Channel Detail — Message Thread
prd_journeys: Send a message in a channel
Attach a ticker card to a message
screens_created.description: Real-time message thread for a single channel. Messages appear chronologically with sender avatar and timestamp. Ticker cards are inline with expandable price widget.
screens_created.layout_notes: Fixed header with channel name, member count, and back chevron. Scrollable message list uses MessageBubble variants. Compose bar pinned to bottom above safe area. Ticker card attachment button (chart icon) in compose bar toolbar.

screens_created.name: Ticker Search — Attach to Message
prd_journeys: Attach a ticker card to a message
screens_created.description: Bottom sheet triggered from the compose bar. User searches by ticker symbol or company name. Tapping a result attaches a TickerCard to the pending message.
screens_created.layout_notes: Modal bottom sheet using existing Sheet component pattern. InputField/focused at top. Results list reuses existing InstrumentSearchResult list item component. Shows last price, change %, and market status inline.

interactions.notes: Returns to thread with ticker card pre-attached in compose

screens_created.name: Ticker Card Detail
prd_journeys: View live ticker data from a message
screens_created.description: Expanded view of a TickerCard tapped from a message. Shows live price, intraday chart, bid/ask, volume, and a Buy / Sell CTA linking to the existing order flow.
screens_created.layout_notes: Reuses existing TickerCard/expanded component as the header card. Intraday chart uses existing QuoteChart component. Bottom CTAs are Button/Primary (Buy) and Button/Ghost (Sell). Safe area respected at bottom.

interactions.notes: Hands off to existing order flow — out of scope for messaging

screens_created.name: Create Channel
screens_created.description: Simple form to create a new public channel. Name (required, unique), optional topic, and a Create button. Inline validation on name uniqueness.
screens_created.layout_notes: Screen-level form with header. Two InputField stacks: Name (with character counter at 50 chars) and Topic (optional, 140 chars). Button/Primary at bottom pinned to keyboard safe area. Error state uses color/status/error inline below Name field.

interactions.notes: Navigates to newly created channel on success

navigation_flow:
BottomNav (Chat Tab) → Channel List
Channel List → Channel Detail (tap row)
Channel List → Create Channel (tap +)
Channel Detail → Ticker Search (tap chart icon)
Channel Detail → Ticker Card Detail (tap ticker card)
Ticker Search → Channel Detail (select ticker)
Create Channel → Channel Detail (on success)
notes: Figma write is deferred (FIGMA_MOCKUP_FILE not configured in this demo run). All frame_id and frame_url fields are empty placeholders. Design gaps identified: ModeratedMessagePlaceholder and ChannelEmptyState components need to be added to the design system before production handoff. Ticker Card Detail reuses existing QuoteChart and TickerCard components — confirm node IDs with the design system owner before writing frames.
